name: @al-ft/l1-node-transport
description: One long-lived node-to-client sidecar per process: chain-sync, local state query, submit and mempool monitor over one framed pipe

scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" vitest.config.ts tsup.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json README.md "testing/**/*.{mjs,d.mts}"
scripts.format-check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" vitest.config.ts tsup.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json README.md "testing/**/*.{mjs,d.mts}"
scripts.native:test: go -C native vet ./... && go -C native test -race ./...
